# CANDIDATE: BEARISH_REJECTION_VIX_FILTER_TIGHTEN

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Tightening the VIX confirmation threshold for bearish entries (requiring VIX > 22 instead of the current >20) will reduce false signals during low-volatility regimes, preserving edge on J winner days while avoiding losses on choppy days. This aims to improve the signal quality without regressing on the three J winner days.

## Mechanism

Modify the VIX confirmation filter in the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup (context filters) to require VIX > 22 at time of entry for put trades. All other context filters, trigger conditions, contract selection, stop, and exit rules remain unchanged. The change is isolated to the VIX threshold parameter.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline P&L (based on ITM-2 0DTE put premium ~$1.00 entry).
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest will use 16-month SPY 5m data (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with OPRA real-fills simulation. Selection method: all bars passing BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON context filters except VIX threshold. Overfit risk: moderate (single parameter change on existing rule).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window pending Stage-1 completion).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA simulation on top 3 J days pending Stage-1 completion).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: whipsaw in low-VIX regime causing missed entries on strong bearish days (e.g., 4/29 if VIX <22).
   - Max drawdown: potential increase if filter removes winning trades during volatility expansion.
   - Blow-up scenario: persistent low-VIX bearish trends where filter rejects all entries, forcing zero P&L.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (will compute top-5 days % of P&L post-backtest).
